name: A Studied Seduction
source:
Arthur Ruthven's thirty-fifth birthday is fast approaching, but he's worried that his life has started to stagnate.

Once a history teacher in Leith, an incident with a former pupil causes Arthur to retire early. Newly uneasy about teaching, and unsure if he can pursue the career he once loved, Arthur returns to his childhood home in the small village of Colinton, to live with his mother.

For the last three years, Arthur has worked with his mother in his family's old bookshop in obscurity. He would prefer to forget his days as a teacher, and the anxieties which came with them...

But Arthur can only keep his past at bay for so long, and his life takes an unexpected turn when his mother hires a new helper at the bookshop over the summer holidays: one Mason Tierney, one of Arthur's former students.

Mason has done some growing up in the five years since Arthur last saw him, and now, he's already twenty-one. Mason tries to be friendly with Arthur, but Arthur begins to worry. Is Mason being too friendly - and will Mason's interest in Arthur stir up uncomfortable memories Arthur would far rather see buried for good?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4941130/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
阿瑟·鲁斯文 (Arthur Ruthven) 的三十五岁生日即将来临，但他担心自己的生活已经开始停滞不前。

亚瑟曾经是利斯的历史老师，与一名前学生发生的事件导致亚瑟提前退休。亚瑟对教学感到不安，也不确定自己是否能继续从事自己曾经热爱的职业，他回到了童年时位于科林顿小村庄的家，与母亲住在一起。

在过去的三年里，亚瑟和他的母亲一起默默无闻地在自家的旧书店里工作。他宁愿忘记自己当老师的日子，以及随之而来的焦虑……

但亚瑟只能将自己的过去抛在脑后，而当他的母亲在暑假期间在书店雇用了一位新帮手时，他的生活发生了意想不到的转变：梅森·蒂尔尼，亚瑟以前的学生之一。

自从亚瑟上次见到他以来的五年里，梅森已经成长了一些，现在他已经二十一岁了。梅森试图与亚瑟友好相处，但亚瑟开始担心。梅森是否太友好了——梅森对亚瑟的兴趣是否会激起亚瑟宁愿永远被埋葬的不舒服的回忆？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4941130/]Steam[/url]]
